calculation_handling.description: Measurement rule: in the Residential Zone category, the height of an ancillary building or structure is measured from average grade (not established grade) to its highest point.
calculation_handling.gaps: Defines height_m for ancillary buildings/structures only; the measurement base is average grade, which differs from the established-grade base of principal-building height. Not a Chapter 800 row, so input_fidelity is not keyed.

calculation_handling.description: Maximum height 2.5 m for an ancillary building or structure in the Residential Zone category located less than 1.8 m from the residential building on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: distance_to_residential_m is a scenario value (where the ancillary building is placed); with no placement the arm cannot be selected.

calculation_handling.description: Maximum height 4.0 m for an ancillary building or structure in the Residential Zone category in all other cases (located 1.8 m or more from the residential building).
calculation_handling.gaps: 'In all other cases' is the complement of (2)(A); the 1.8 m threshold does not occur in this unit's text, so no condition is keyed and the lower 2.5 m max of (2)(A) governs where its condition holds.

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building or structure in the Residential Zone category may not have more than one storey.
calculation_handling.gaps: The limit is written as the word 'one'; keyed as the numeral 1 storeys.

calculation_handling.description: The top of an entrance into an ancillary building or structure in the Residential Zone category may be at most 2.5 m above the average elevation of the ground along the entrance.
calculation_handling.gaps: No DSL target fits: entrance_height_m is the elevation of a main pedestrian entrance / first floor above established grade, not the height of the top of an ancillary-building entrance (e.g. a garage door) above the ground along it. Keyed UNUSUAL; the 2.5 is the limit itself and no literal_not_expressed_reason fits exactly (threshold_used_in_application is the closest closed value).

units.disclosure: The top of a door or opening into a garage, shed or other accessory building can be no more than 2.5 m above the ground along that entrance. We do not check entrance heights.

evidence.deck_or_platform: a platform, such as a deck

calculation_handling.description: In the Residential Zone category, a platform (deck or similar structure, other than a green roof) may not be located on top of any ancillary building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Platform placement is a design fact; not evaluated.

units.disclosure: A deck or similar platform (other than a green roof) cannot be built on top of a garage, shed or other accessory building. We do not check platform placement.

evidence.deck_or_platform: a platform, such as a deck

calculation_handling.description: In the Residential Zone category, a platform (other than a green roof) more than 1.2 m above the ground at any point below it may not be attached to an ancillary building or structure containing a parking space.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 1.2 m test is on the platform's height above the ground below it; no lot_condition threshold token reads platform height, so it is not keyed as condition.if. Design fact; not evaluated.

units.disclosure: A deck or platform more than 1.2 m above the ground cannot be attached to a garage or other accessory building that holds a parking space. We do not check deck placement.

10.5.60.40(1).explanation: For accessory buildings and structures in residential zones, height is measured from the average ground level to the highest point of the building.

10.5.60.40(2).explanation: An accessory building or structure in a residential zone can be at most 2.5 m tall if it is less than 1.8 m from the house, and at most 4.0 m tall otherwise.

10.5.60.40(3).explanation: An accessory building or structure in a residential zone can have only one storey.

10.5.60.40(4).explanation: The top of the entrance into an accessory building (for example a garage door) can be at most 2.5 m above the ground along that entrance.

10.5.60.40(5).explanation: A deck or similar platform (not a green roof) cannot sit on top of an accessory building, and cannot be attached to a garage or other accessory building holding a parking space if the platform is more than 1.2 m above the ground.
